borrowed: recursive fn read(a:const i64[2]&)->i64[..3]{return -a;}fn main(){var a:i64[2]=[7,-8];let b=read(a);assert(b.len==2);assert(b[0] == -7);assert(b[1]==8);assert(a[0]==7);print("borrowed");}
call_defer: var source:i64[2]=[7,-8];recursive fn make()->i64[2]{defer source[0]=99;return source;}fn main(){let b:i64[..3]=-make();assert(b.len==2);assert(b[0] == -7);assert(b[1]==8);assert(source[0]==99);print("call_defer");}
loop_exit: recursive fn make()->i64[2]{return [7,-8];}fn main(){var i=0;while i<4{print("head");let b:i64[..3]=-make();i++;if i<4{continue;}assert(b.len==2);assert(b[0] == -7);assert(b[1]==8);}print("loop_exit");}
function_data: struct H{values:i64[..3]}recursive fn run(a:i64[2]&)->i64{var rows:H[]=[H{-a}];assert(rows[0].values.len==2);assert(rows[0].values[0] == -a[0]);assert(rows[0].values[1]==8);return rows[0].values[0]+rows[0].values[1];}recursive fn parent(a:i64[2]&)->i64{var held:H[]=[H{values:[1]}];let n=run(a);assert(held[0].values.len==1);assert(held[0].values[0]==1);return n;}fn main(){var a:i64[2]=[7,-8];let x=run(a);a[0]=9;let y=parent(a);assert(x==1);assert(y == -1);print("function_data");}
